chapter: A Gift From the Sea Spirits
act_title: A Gift From the Sea Spirits

quests.title: A Gift From the Sea Spirits

dialogue.t: Hey there, Melusine friend! Need any help?
Oh! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's you! Long time no see!

dialogue.sit: Puca! Nice to see you again too.
Looking for pretty rocks again?

dialogue.t: Hehe, right in one! You know me too well.
Everyone in Merusea is preparing a surprise gift for Monsieur Neuvillette. We're working together to make him a new outfit! I was about to go find some gems and shells to decorate it with!

dialogue.sit: Wow, a surprise present!

dialogue.t: Wow, a surprise present!
Uh, is it really okay for you to tell us like that, though?
Ahhh! Oh no...
Sorry, it's my first time doing something like this, so it just slipped out...
I'm not sure why, but seeing everyone working towards the same goal like this, my heart just won't stop racing...
Paimon totally gets it! The mood's just so infectious that you get swept up in the hype and you just can't stop, won't stop, right?

dialogue.sit: It's like forming a band.
Like co-conspirators committing a crime together.

dialogue.t: Yeah, it is! We may be playing different instruments, but we're playing in harmony, making the same music!
So, why'd everyone suddenly decide to give him a gift?
Oh, that! Monsieur Neuvillette is always sending gifts to everyone in Merusea Village, so after discussing it, we decided to make something for him ourselves!

Flo handled the blueprints, and then we all picked out the materials and sewed it together... And Serene was in charge of "emergency precautions" to prevent things from getting totally out of control.
Emergency precautions? Things getting out of control?
Uh, Paimon knows that making clothes with Melusine hands is hard, but how bad could it possibly get?
That depends on your definition of bad.
Does it count if we ask Mamere to make a huge painting, and then turn the canvas into pajamas?
Oh wow. About that...

dialogue.sit: I think Neuvillette would love it.

dialogue.t: Hehe, me too!
But like Serene said, it's better if we make a respectable outfit that he can proudly wear when he's out and about!
Laume's got tons of experience, so we had her get a whole bundle of fashion magazines, and asked Sigewinne what "respectable" meant, before we finally settled on "solemn relaxation" as the theme.
"Solemn relaxation"... Paimon can't help but picture Neuvillette swimming around with a serious look when she hears that...

dialogue.sit: Speaking of which, you've still got shells on you, yes?

dialogue.t: Huh?
Oh, right! Shells! I was so busy talking with you, I almost forgot my job...
Sorry, I've gotta go! I can't hold everyone else up because I was enjoying myself too much...
I need to find some shiny shells and rocks pronto, and grind them up into shiny powder! I'm not sure if I have enough Tidalga for the dye, either...

dialogue.sit: In that case, I think it's time for our line...

dialogue.t: "Leave it to us!"
When it comes to finding stuff, we're the best in the biz! As much as you need, on time, guaranteed!
Really? You will? Thank you so much!
Then... Could you please help me find some of the shiniest, brightest Beryl Conches? I remember there's a bunch in the waters around here, two or three should be enough.
Hehe, even 20 or 30 would be a piece of cake!
Oh, that's way too many!
I'll focus on finding gems over here! Good luck to us, see you soon!
Thanks so much for your help, and stay safe!
Puca! Are you okay?
*whimper*... I never imagined I'd dig up an Armored Crab digging for gems...

dialogue.sit: (Armored Crab? Isn't that a vishap?)

dialogue.t: It's fine, fine, I'm not hurt... Sorry for making you worry...
Good thing this vishap showed up! Gobbled that nasty crab right up!
Eh!? Vishaps eat giant crabs?

dialogue.sit: That's what you're focused on?

dialogue.t: Maybe they don't actually like crab that much, it doesn't look too thrilled...

dialogue.sit: That's what you're focused on?

dialogue.t: Oh right! We should be focusing on... why is there a vishap here?
No clue! Never seen one around these parts before.
Monsieur Neuvillette warned us that while some vishaps are super friendly, others can be really dangerous, so we shouldn't get too close.
Whew... Seems I'm pretty lucky, running into such a cute vishap like this!

dialogue.sit: (Cute... vishap? ...Wait...)

dialogue.t: Then be sure to give it a proper thank you the next time you run into it, okay?
Yeah, for sure! And I'll treat it to something tasty too! Only thing is that I'm not sure what it likes... Definitely not giant crabs, though!

dialogue.sit: Tidalga.

dialogue.t: Tidalga? Wouldn't have thought such a big vishap would like something...
Whoa! Tidalga! When did that get there!?
Huh? So this pile of Tidalga isn't yours?
Nope! Haven't even had a chance to dive in yet... Did some kind soul overhear us and leave it here?

dialogue.sit: Perhaps some nice fairy.

dialogue.t: Looks like I really am super lucky today! Can't believe that fashion magazine horoscope was actually accurate...
Then may the stars watch over us, that our gift may arrive safe and sound!

dialogue.sit: It will, certainly.

dialogue.t: Oh yeah, here! These are the Beryl Conches we gathered. Are these enough?
Plenty! Whoooa, so sparkly, I can barely open my eyes...

dialogue.sit: Laying it on a bit thick, aren't we?
Had to wear shades the whole time I was looking.

dialogue.t: Hehe, that's just how I like to express how grateful I am!
Well then, with my gems, your Beryl Conches, and the nice fairy's Tidalga, my mission here is complete!
If everything goes this well, the clothes should be ready in a couple days!
Hey, when we deliver the clothes to the Palais Mermonia, will you two come see what we made?

dialogue.sit: Of course.

dialogue.t: Hehe, let's meet up at the Palais Mermonia then! A whole bunch of us Melusines will be there!
Sounds great! We'll be looking forward to hearing from you!

dialogue.section: Iaune, Laume, Granna, Virda, Flo, Puca

dialogue.t: Wow, it's been a long time since Paimon's seen the Palais Mermonia this busy! Puca wasn't kidding, there are a ton of Melusines...
Huh? Something's off, though. Everyone feels kinda... tense?
Um, excuse me? Miss...
Mr. Gestionnaire! Do you enjoy your work here in the Palais Mermonia?
Uh, are you... are you asking me?
Err, well, about that, I can't really say I'm happy, or particularly unhappy... Though I've been here for some time now, I still feel as though I only just started...
Got it, so put another way... Work at the Palais Mermonia is so exciting that it feels as though you're always filled with energy — like you're in your prime, correct?
Exciting? Oh, no, no! More anxious, really...
An exciting anxiety? Is being a Gestionnaire really that nerve-wracking? And here I thought only the Marechaussee Phantom was like that.
Oh, no, no! It musn't be exciting. If anything on the job excites your nerves, that means the process has already gone terribly wrong...
Is that so? Sedile never mentioned anything like that.
Sedile... Ah, you mean Officer Sedile of the Marechaussee Phantom? Wait, are you her colleague?
Of course not! If we're talking ability, I definitely would've passed the exam first!
Granna, now's not the time to get competitive! Look at the poor man, he's so nervous he's sweating bullets.
Really? I thought that if someone looks really nervous during an interview, that means you're asking the right questions.
Ahem! Excuse me, Mr. Gestionnaire, are there any troubles in your work life that you find difficult to discuss?
Pardon me, but, interview? Am I being interviewed right now?
Well, yeah!
Oh, no. Oh no no no no...
According to regulations, Gestionnaires are strictly forbidden from giving private interviews, especially to parties of unknown provenance...
Excuse me, Miss Melusine, but might I inquire your full name and the newspaper at which you are currently employed?
Uh... Special Reporter Laume, for the "Buoyant Otter Gazette"!
(You obviously just made that up...! Laume, what happened to truth in reporting!?)
Hmm... Does the Court of Fontaine really have a paper like that? I'll... I need to go check the files...
My good sir, are you feeling alright? You certainly look as though your nerves have been excited right now...
...Right, the process! Sorry, good ladies, could you please wait here for a moment? I need to go find a colleague from the publishing office...
(Oh, for... We were just going to ask him how to get to Monsieur Neuvillette's office... Yet somehow, it turned into a practice interview for Laume...)
Mr. Iaune! There you are!
The tea Miss Cornelia so kindly made for us is nearly cold, just what have you... Oh my word! What happened here? Why are there so many Melusines?
Ah! Mr. Roialte, please, give me a hand. I can't possibly take care of all these Melusines myself, much less give an interview while I'm at it...
Interview? I never saw any such thing on the schedule. Which newspaper?
The "Buoyant Otter Gazette."
Ah? Really? Yet what you're holding certainly doesn't look like an otter.
Of course not! This happens to be the one we're looking for this time.
Eh? This blue creature can't be me, can it? Looks nothing like me...
HEY! Watch what you're calling a blue creature. This is none other than the eminent Monsieur Neuvillette!
Eh!?
I see...
Mr. Iaune, please refrain from undue alarm. I understand that your heavy workload and lack of sleep might have left you rather tightly wound, but you must remain calm.
As you well know, the world looks profoundly different through Melusine eyes. Thus, it is entirely possible that to them, the Iudex appears... well, like that.
Mmm, pretty much! Monsieur Neuvillette actually looks a bit different to every Melusine, so we split the difference.
Ah, you split the difference? I see, a most judicious approach.
In that case, might I inquire what matter you wish to see Monsieur Neuvillette about?
We're here to give him a g...
...Gun salute! A 21-gun salute for Monsieur Neuvillette, hehe...
(Phew! That was a close call, we almost told someone else about the secret gift again!)
...A—A gun salute? Inside the Palais Mermonia? Inside the Iudex's office?
Mr. Roialte, please calm down, you're also becoming unduly alarmed...
Um, err, can you say something? Paimon's getting scared...

dialogue.sit: Sorry. I'm naturally the silent type.

dialogue.t: Please don't make Paimon beg! Stop rubbernecking!

dialogue.sit: It feels like I'm watching a play unfold in real time.
Sorry, lost myself for a second.

dialogue.t: It's not that Paimon can't sympathize, but it looks like Roialte's really about to call the Gardes...
And if he really calls Neuvillette over, then the surprise they worked so hard to prepare will be for nothing, and things'll get waaay more awkward...

dialogue.sit: Fine, you've convinced me.
Let's do this!

dialogue.t: What do you mean "this"? Do what exactly!?

dialogue.sit: Heya, Puca, everyone, so great to see you all here!

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}, Paimon!
Huh?
...Mr. Roialte?
Pardon me, but are you with them?

dialogue.sit: We are. We agreed to visit Neuvillette together.
We are. We agreed to visit a certain blue creature together.

dialogue.t: Everything should be in order, then. Monsieur Neuvillette is currently in his office, and should not be receiving any other guests at this time. You may proceed.
What, we don't need to confirm their identities and so on?
There's no need.
Would you look at that? Mr. Iaune keeps his nose so firmly to the grindstone that he seldom has a chance to look up and register all the Palais Mermonia's esteemed visitors...

dialogue.sit: It's fine, we're the ones imposing...

dialogue.t: You're too gracious. We shan't delay you or your Melusine friends any longer, save for one minor thing...
Eh? Wazzat?
While inside the Palais Mermonia, particularly in the offices, please ensure that any items you're holding remain below head level.
Otherwise, our most enthusiastic colleagues will doubtlessly assume you have a special request you plan to seek assistance with.
Got it! We were only holding it because everyone was scared of getting lost in the Court of Fontaine, but now that we've reached our destination... Puca, if you would...
Sure, Flo! Putting it away...
Ohhh! So that's what it was for!
It's fine! With the two of us here, there's no way you're getting lost! Come on, Neuvillette's office is right over there...
Mr. Roialte...
No need for the long face! That's {NICKNAME}, a good friend of the Iudex. No trouble will come of it.
And even if something does happen, it will have had nothing to do with you or me. We were both drinking Miss Cornelia's tea.
Ah, it's you.
{NICKNAME}! Feels like ages since I last saw you. How've you been?

dialogue.sit: All's well, things've been going great.

dialogue.t: Haa, that's great to hear! As you can see, this place hasn't changed a bit...
Heh.... Pardon me, but are you with the Melusines?

dialogue.sit: We are. We agreed to visit Neuvillette together.
We are. We agreed to visit a certain blue creature together.

dialogue.t: Point is... Wonderful! The problem has suddenly solved itself.
Monsieur Neuvillette is currently in his office, and should not be receiving any other guests at this time. You may proceed.

dialogue.sit: Sorry to impose...

dialogue.t: You're too gracious. We shan't delay you or your Melusine friends any longer, save for one minor thing...
Eh? Wazzat?
While inside the Palais Mermonia, particularly in the offices, please ensure that any items you're holding remain below head level.
Otherwise, our most enthusiastic colleagues will doubtlessly assume you have a special request you plan to seek assistance with.
Got it! We were only holding it because everyone was scared of getting lost in the Court of Fontaine, but now that we've reached our destination... Puca, if you would...
Sure, Flo! Putting it away...
Ohhh! So that's what it was for!
It's fine! With the two of us here, there's no way you're getting lost! Come on, Neuvillette's office is right over there...
Please, take care, everyone.
Communicating with Melusines always requires a bit more effort. The usual methods simply aren't very effective...
There's something else I've been wondering... Can't seem to wrap my head around it.
And what's that?
Think about it! Melusines are all so kind and clever, and they live practically forever! They're perfectly suited for our line of work, aren't they?
Iaune, my dear boy...
You just listed every reason they'd make disastrous Gestionnaires.
Okay then, please lead the way to Monsieur Neuvillette's office!

dialogue.sit: Follow me, and stay close to the group, no wandering, thank you...
Just a moment.

dialogue.t: Ah, I thought it might be you.
I had heard Melusine voices, and went to the window for a look... Only to find the angle was wrong, and I couldn't see a thing.
...I trust you encountered no difficulties on your way?
No, not at all! Uh, well, not exactly...

dialogue.sit: You briefly fill Neuvillette in on what happened...

dialogue.t: I see...
*ahem* ...Laume, you were indeed the first at fault here. You must secure the consent of others before making requests, and mustn't impede their duties or daily lives.
Extra caution should be exercised with matters such as interviews.
I see... I'm sorry...

dialogue.sit: And the "Buoyant Otter Gazette" desperately needs rebranding.

dialogue.t: The what Gazette?
It's nothing! I—I'll go find them both and apologize right now!
Hey, remember to greet them politely first, even when you're apologizing!
(Yes, that should suffice... Lecturing's never been my strong suit...)
Now, back to the matter at hand. How might I help you all today?
Hehe... It's probably best if the Melusines tell you themselves!
Um...
(Oh, zounds! We were all so busy making the gift, we never stopped to plan how to actually give it to Monsieur Neuvillette so it feels like a surprise!)
(It'd be perfect if we could actually give a gun salute right about now! KA-BOOM BOOM, it'd be totally... wait, no! No gun salutes allowed in offices, right?)
(If only Laume was here, she's so carefree... Laume, come on, it's our hour of need!)
I'm baack! Those two gentlemen are both great people! They not only didn't scold me, but they even served me tea, too!
Huh? Why haven't you given him the clothes yet? I already finished two whole cups!
(AAH! She just said it like it was nothing!)
Clothes?
Uh, uhm... That's, um...

dialogue.sit: You've come this far.
Just give it to him!

dialogue.t: Yeah, you're right...

dialogue.sit: The Melusines practically fall over themselves as they cheerfully clamor to explain the "surprise gift" and how it all came about...

dialogue.t: I'm telling you, I saw it in a magazine before...
Uh, you sure? You're not making it up, are you?
Come on out, now. It's me.
New Valet, Pahsiv! Pahsiv!
Whoa, it's Pahsiv! So, you know Neuvillette?
"Pahsiv"? This is how you address her, then?

dialogue.sit: Wait, does this mean the legendary "new valet" is none other than...
We'll have to tell Cyno first chance we get.

dialogue.t: That's what she meant!? Oh... And to think that it used to keep Paimon up at night, tossing and turning... Even lost sleep over it...
Hello...?
Waah... Melusine... ka-pow...
Puca, allow me to introduce you. This here is the nice vishap... Err, nice vishap lady who helped you before.
Whoa, vishaps can turn into Melusines? That's so cool! Now we can hold hands!
Thank you for saving me. How about I treat you to a nice meal?
Tide... Tidalga?
Hmm? Yeah! Tidalga!
Tidalga! Tidalga! Tidalga Tidalga!
I take it you really like Tidalga?
Wait, that means you gave us your favorite food... Wow! Thank you so, so much!
Thank you, Pahsiv.
Pahsiv, New Valet, ka-pow!
If that's the case, why not picnic here with us?
I'll handle the food! I caused everyone so much trouble back at the Palais Mermonia, it's the least I can do!
Then I'll prep some tidalga for Pahsiv!

dialogue.sit: Everyone works hard to prepare the delicious meal before enjoying it together.

dialogue.section: Laume, Neuvillette, Virda, Puca, Flo, Granna

dialogue.t: Monsieur Neuvillette! Can I ask a question?
Of course you may.
I've heard that Liyue has fire wrapped in paper, lights that can grant any wish! Is that true?
Fire wrapped in paper? Wouldn't it break? And isn't that dangerous?
Yeah, that's right! If your wish is to burn the whole house down, then it might come true.
Whoooa, Puca! Where'd you learn to joke like that?
Eh? I wasn't joking...
Well... There is something like that. They're called "Xiao Lanterns."
They aren't dangerous if properly handled, but they do not actually have the power to grant wishes... I'm sorry.
Awww, you don't need to apologize!
Heh... Simply listening to me describe them would be quite dull. How about I bring some back for you once I visit Liyue?
That'd be amazing! And it'd be even better if you can take some more pictures this time!
Consider it done.

quests.description: By the gentle shores of Fontaine, you and Paimon meet a Melusine who needs your help…
